hookText: SSD prices may begin to decline in the latter half

beats.say: SSD prices may start to decline in the latter half of 2027, according to an analysis of storage pricing trends.
Hard drives will take longer, probably into 2028, because the factories that make them have already sold that output.
In its July NAND update, TrendForce said the market would run a 4 to 5% supply deficit through 2026, then move back into balance in the second half of 2027.
